description: This file defines the SystemUIModesOverlay class, which extends the SystemUIModes class and sets up a window with action bar overlay feature in its onCreate method.

classes.name: SystemUIModesOverlay
classes.description: A subclass of SystemUIModes that configures the window to overlay the action bar mode.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Overrides the onCreate method to request the FEATURE_ACTION_BAR_OVERLAY feature for the window.
